sentences.text:
1  SRI B.R.PRASHANTH, ADVOCATE FOR R2)
 THIS MSA IS FILED UNDER SECTION 54(2) OF LAND  ACQUISITION ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT DATED  25.02.2017 PASSED IN LAC APPEAL 178/2017 ON THE FILE OF  3rd ADDITIONAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, HASSAN,
 PARTLY ALLOWING THE APPEAL AND MODIFYING THE  JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 25.02.2017 PASSED IN LAC  -2-  NC: 2025:KHC:35052  MSA No. 67 of 2025 HC-KAR NO.56/2016 ON THE FILE OF SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND JMFC,
ARAKALGUD, PARTLY ALLOWING THE REFERENCE PETITION FILED UNDER SECTION 18(1) OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT.
 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE V SRISHANANDA  ORAL ORDER Heard Sri Manoj Kumar J.Y., learned counsel for the appellant, Sri Gopalkrishna Soodi, learned Additional Government Advocate for respondent No.1 and Sri B.R. Prashanth, learned counsel for respondent No.2.
2.

Joint memo is filed, which reads as under:
"It is respectfully submitted that this Hon'ble Court Co-ordinate Bench in M.S.A.No.24/2023 c/w 25/23 had enhanced the compensation to Rs.45,000/- per gunta vide order dated 15.11.2024.
It is now prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to pass an order in the above cases in accordance with the M.S.A.No.24/23 c/w 25/23, in the interest of justice and equity."

3. The Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in respect of the very same project has enhanced the compensation amount NC: 2025:KHC:35052 HC-KAR in a sum of Rs.10,000/- as against the order of the First Appellate Court granting Rs.35,000/- per gunta.
4. In the present case, the claimant is also entitled for Rs.45,000/- per gunta, in view of the order passed in MSA No.24/2023 C/w MSA No.25/2023, dated 15.11.2024.

Accordingly, the following:
Sri M B Shivappa vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer on 3 September, 2025

sentences.text:
2 ORDER (i) Miscellaneous Second Appeal is allowed.
(ii) As against the sum of Rs.35,000/- per gunta granted by the First Appellate Court in respect of the acquired land, appellant/claimant is entitled to Rs.45,000/- per gunta with consequential benefits.
(iii) Office to pass modified award accordingly.

Sd/-
